description: Formal production contract for Solomon knowledge layers — frozen at CG-5 close, operationalized in CG-6.

layers.label: Manufacturer / Platform Family
layers.scope: Manufacturer implementation vocabulary, OEM aliases, topology, procedure bindings

layers.label: Model / Model-Line
layers.scope: OEM surface variants that do not justify platform promotion
layers.storage: platform family oemTermAliases + procedure seeds scoped to platformId

layers.label: Diagnostic Session Evidence
layers.scope: Facts, measurements, procedure runs, and derived intelligence for one repair
layers.note: Session evidence NEVER auto-promotes to ontology, platform, or model layers.

requires: Same functional concept observed across sufficiently independent manufacturers and/or platforms
Human gate classification newCanonicalKnowledge with explicit rationale
Not merely repeated OEM terminology or single-manufacturer platform vocabulary
explicitlyNot: Seen this term N times within one manufacturer
Physically similar part on a different platform without functional equivalence review
Single unfamiliar manual or repair outcome

frozenControlGroup.rule: Remain frozen until extraordinary multi-manufacturer functional evidence

requires: Human gate classification newPlatformKnowledge OR inherited_platform_family on publish
Stored in manufacturer overlay add.components / oemTermAliases / bindings
May inherit across models within same manufacturer platform family
explicitlyNot: Automatic promotion to canonical because concept is useful
Cross-manufacturer platform vocabulary transfer (e.g. Whirlpool → Samsung)

requires: Maps to existing canonical or platform target without creating duplicate platform concepts

session.rule: Verified repair outcomes feed review queues; they do not silently rewrite ontology or overlays.
session.futureFeedback: DMA/outcome→KB must classify which layer evidence justifies before promotion

architectureInvariants: Better matching may increase automatic inheritance; it must NEVER lower the promotion bar
Gate-preview metrics are authoritative for compounding curves; post-publish metrics are debug-only
Raw gate preview artifacts must be preserved separately from human-resolved classifications
Manufacturer platform vocabulary does not transfer across manufacturers — only canonical ontology and compiler machinery

Explicit platformId is authoritative over model-pattern inference — when platformId is set, only the matching platform family may participate; other families must not fall through to modelPatterns (see cg6-samsung-dryer-routing-boundary.test.ts)

semanticInheritance.abstentionPolicy: R5 frozen — partial signal without full deterministic evidence → human gate
semanticInheritance.matcherMustNot: Auto-promote to newPlatformKnowledge or newCanonicalKnowledge; cross-manufacturer inherit; topology inference; create concepts on high-risk functional rules
